name: Semantic_Relaxation_Scenarios
description: Replaces the explicit arithmetic hints ("set duration to 0", "remove limits") with physical scenario relaxations (dedicated hardware per subsystem, bypassing a phase completely). This forces the model to deduce that dedicated hardware implies a parallel makespan of `p1+p2` and bypassing a phase on a serial bottleneck implies a makespan of `sum(p)`. It prevents simple regex/pattern matching on the explicit mathematical hints present in the seed while maintaining exact algorithmic equivalence.
